<void/>Void Kills grant 'Abyssal Extractors' for 2.5 seconds. While active, kills with Soul Siphon and <void/>Void Kills on <void/>Suppressed enemies grant 4 seconds. Duration can be extended up to 20 seconds.

<void/>Soul Siphon hits inflict <void/>Suppression for <pve 10 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds.

Abyssal Extractor grants the following benefits:
• 300% additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Recharge Rate
• 200% additional Base Super and Class Ability Recharge Rate
